celestial_assets.apollo_view: The parent planet is a 1.3MB 3D mesh (planet01.mesh) with its own textures. The moon has TWO texture sets. The starfield is 10.9 MB. The sky system uses SkyX (a Caelum-based sky renderer for Ogre3D). Kenshi APOLLO = looking UP from the moon surface to see the parent planet hanging in the sky. Kenshi NEPTUNE = looking DOWN from orbit at the 870km² moon continent.
celestial_assets.what_kenshiReborn_does: We extract these assets and render them with barraCuda Vulkan. The planet becomes NAVIGABLE. The space elevator becomes CLIMBABLE. The orbital weapons become CONTROLLABLE. You can SEE the moon from orbit.

WAS.description: What the Kenshi universe LOOKED like before. The archaeology.
WAS.first_empire: Space elevators, orbital weapons, genetic engineering, Behemoths, automated factories. Near-godlike.
WAS.second_empire: Cat-Lon's atonement→corruption→madness. Hydraulic Knights, Enforcers, child prisons, thralls.
WAS.the_extinction: Skeletons nearly wiped out humanity. Stobe stopped it. The First Empire collapsed.
WAS.the_old_world_map: The game went through a MAJOR map revision during development. The 'Old World' is a different map entirely (accessible via Steam beta branch).
WAS.kenshi_development: 12+ years. One man (Chris Hunt). Security guard → solo dev → 33-person studio. Ogre engine after 2 false starts.

NOW.description: What we are doing RIGHT NOW with meitou.
NOW.next_step: Install RE_Kenshi → Install KenshiLua → Write our first Lua scripts → Test in-game

apollo.what: The view FROM the moon looking UP. What the player sees in Kenshi's sky.
apollo.parent_planet: A massive blue/green planet (planet01.mesh, 1.3 MB 3D model). Always in the same position (tidal lock). Has visible surface features — possibly oceans, continents.
apollo.second_moon: A smaller body between the planet and the game world. All three in geostationary orbit.
apollo.orbital_debris: SpaceJunk01.mesh — wreckage of First Empire spacecraft
apollo.space_elevator: Ashland_Skylink.mesh (5.2 MB!) — hovering above the Ashlands with no visible support
apollo.eye_satellites: Ring-shaped orbital weapons. One crashed (The Eye region). One STILL FIRING (Venge).
apollo.starfield: SkyX_Starfield.dds (10.9 MB) — massive detailed star field

neptune.what: The view FROM ORBIT looking DOWN at the moon. What Apollo 8 astronauts saw.
neptune.the_moon_surface: 870 km², 29.5 km × 29.5 km continent. 64×64 grid of 460.8m blocks. ~70 zones.
what_you_see_from_orbit: ACID GREEN — the Deadlands, pollution zones (northeast)
VOLCANIC RED — the Ashlands, Cat-Lon's domain (southeast)
BURNING ORANGE — Venge, where the orbital weapon fires (central-east)
LUSH GREEN — Greenbeach, Okran's Gulf, the fertile belt (northwest)
DESERT TAN — Stenn Desert, Great Desert, Border Zone (central)
SWAMP DARK — the Swamp, Fog Islands, perpetual darkness (west)
SNOW WHITE — the Leviathan Coast (far north)
BLACK — the Black Desert, poison gas cloud (east)
The continent is surrounded by ACID SEA
neptune.not_in_game: Kenshi has NO orbital view. The camera maxes out at a fixed zoom level. THIS IS WHAT KENSHIREBORN ADDS — satellite view zoom from orbit to ground.
neptune.what_kenshiReborn_does: 4 zoom layers: Satellite → Strategic → Tactical → First Person. See the whole moon. See the orbital weapons. See the space elevator from above. Command armies from orbit like Ender.

unnamed_celestial_bodies.the_moon: HAS NO NAME. 'Kenshi' means 'swordsman' — it's never referenced in-game. THE WORLD HAS NO NAME.
unnamed_celestial_bodies.the_planet: HAS NO NAME. Players call it 'the parent planet.' Some theorize it's the original human homeworld.
unnamed_celestial_bodies.the_second_moon: HAS NO NAME. Smaller body visible in the sky.
unnamed_celestial_bodies.the_star: HAS NO NAME. The sun/star that the system orbits.
unnamed_celestial_bodies.WE_NAME_THEM: In KenshiReborn, WE name what isn't named. The moon becomes a character. The planet becomes reachable. The star system becomes a MAP.
